# 4 izbový byt v BA IV, Devínskej Novej Vsi, ul. P. Horova

> 4-bedroom apartment in the centre of Devínska Nová Ves. The apartment is located in an apartment building on the 6th floor, in the centre of Devínska Nová Ves. Nearby facilities include: post office, health centre, primary school, KRAJ grocery store opposite the building, pharmacy located in the shopping centre. The apartment is oriented to the north and south.

- Druh nabídky: predaj

- Plocha: 85.49 m²
- Podlaží: 6
- Stav: čiastočne prerobený
